newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher, market moves to ceiling.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher, market moves to ceiling.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher and prices rallied to what traders view as a temporary cap to the market.
"The market is now up to where a supply of rice is available," a trader said.
Futures have converged to cash and the gains Wednesday "will just recharge the pipeline," he said.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 400 contracts, down from 800 Tuesday.
Rice closed three to 6-1/2 cents per cwt higher, with November up six at $10.30.
